links.outcome: Guideline concordance of AI responses to urogynecology patient queries on a five-element checklist
links.effect: Median guideline concordance was 100% for ChatGPT Health and 98% for ChatGPT Plus (p = 0.298); accuracy did not differ (p = 0.453).
links.quote: Median guideline concordance was 100% for ChatGPT Health and 98% for ChatGPT Plus (p = 0.298).

unlisted_practices: Comparing a health-specific LLM environment against a general-purpose LLM for patient-facing response quality

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of standard LLM (ChatGPT Plus) vs health-specialized LLM (ChatGPT Health) on simulated urogynecological patient queries evaluated by blinded clinicians, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice.
